const text = ref("");
</script>

  <FormField
    label="Description"
    required

    error-message="Use 120 characters or fewer"
    helper-text="Describe your project in a sentence"
    ><Textarea v-model="text" :rows="4"
  /></FormField>
</template>

form.title: In a form
form.description: required, minlength and maxlength are validated by the browser on submit; the value is submitted under name and reset restores the value attribute.

props.defaultValue: Initial value (the value attribute), restored by form.reset(). Like <textarea>, changing it also changes value until the user edits the field.
props.placeholder: Placeholder text shown while the field is empty.
props.readOnly: Read-only: focusable and submitted, but not editable.
props.minLength: Minimum length of the value (validated by the browser).
props.wrap: How the text is wrapped when submitted: soft, hard or off.
props.name: Name under which the value is submitted with the form.
props.disabled: Disables the control: not focusable, not submitted, not validated.
props.required: The control must have a value for the form to be submitted.
props.value: Current value (property; the value attribute sets defaultValue).
props.isDisabled: Whether the control is disabled, by itself or by a disabled <fieldset> (read-only).
props.labels: The <label> elements associated with the element (read-only).
props.validationMessage: Message of the current validation error; empty when valid (read-only).
props.willValidate: Whether the element takes part in constraint validation (read-only).

events.change: The value was committed (blur), re-dispatched from the inner textarea.
events.input: The value changed (each keystroke; native, composed).
events.minerva-input: Same as input, with detail: { value }.
events.minerva-change: Same as change, with detail: { value }.

methods.blur: Removes focus from the inner control.
methods.checkValidity: Checks validity; fires invalid when the element is invalid.
methods.reportValidity: Checks validity and shows the browser's validation message.
methods.setCustomValidity: Sets a custom validation error, or clears it with an empty string.
methods.formResetCallback: Form lifecycle callback called by form.reset(): restores the initial value.
methods.formDisabledCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when an ancestor <fieldset> is disabled or enabled.
methods.formStateRestoreCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when the browser restores the state (history navigation, autofill).
